items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe and hosts the interview; no personal or professional relationship described between Bobby Gordon and Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Bobby was interviewed at the Allegheny Jazz Party in Chautauqua, New York on September 12, 1997 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe. We are interviewing today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and it’s a pleasure to host Bobby Gordon, clarinetist. Welcome to Chautauqua.
